metricMembersBasis: Bought in the last 60 days, of {n} members
metricIssuedBasis: Earned from purchases, not counting expired or adjusted points
loadFailedTitle: The loyalty workbench could not be loaded
loadFailedBody: The data may not be ready yet. Try again in a moment.
readOnlyNote: Only owners and managers can change this. You can look but not edit.
waitingManager: Waiting for an owner or manager to decide.
emptyMembersBody: Members come from your customer list and from every purchase. Bring in the customers you already have.
emptyMembersBodyStaff: Members appear here as customers buy. Ask an owner or manager to bring in the existing customers.
syncButton: Sync customers from the customer list
syncDone: {created} new members, {linked} linked to existing chats.
publicBody: Customers open this link and enter their phone to see points, tier and rewards. Share it on your menu, receipt or page.
publicOff: The page is off. Turn it on in the agent settings.
noMatchBody: Try another name or phone, or choose all tiers.
detailEmptyBody: Choose a member in the list to see their points history and rewards.
birthdayHint: Used for the birthday gift. Leave empty if unknown.
birthdayInvalid: Write the birthday as day/month/year, for example 17/05/1990.
adjustBody: For corrections only. Every adjustment is written in the history with your reason.
adjustPointsHint: Use + to add and - to remove, for example +50 or -20.
adjustPointsInvalid: Enter a whole number other than 0, for example +50 or -20.
adjustReasonRequired: Write the reason for this adjustment.
adjustDone: Recorded and approved by you. The points are updated.
adjustWaiting: Waiting for approval. Open Waiting for approval to decide.
redeemEmpty: No rewards yet. Add them in the Rewards tab.
rewardsEmptyBody: Start from a ready-made set and change it to fit your shop, or add rewards one by one.
rewardsEmptyBodyStaff: An owner or manager adds the rewards here.
rewardCostRequired: Points needed must be 1 or more.
rewardValueHint: What it is worth to you. Used to report the cost of rewards.
promoBody: Choose who should receive it, write the offer, and OpenClaw drafts the message. Nothing is sent until you approve it.
promoManagersOnly: Only owners and managers can send offers
promoManagersOnlyBody: You can still see the offers that were sent below.
segTiersHint: Leave all unticked to include every tier.
segSpendHint: Total spend so far. Leave empty to ignore.
brief: The offer you want to send
briefHint: For example: 10% off any drink this weekend. Write only what is true; the message will not add anything else.
briefRequired: Write the offer you want to send.
submitCampaign: Draft the message and send for approval
createdWaiting: Drafted by OpenClaw in {s} seconds. It is waiting for you in Waiting for approval.
createdWaitingTemplate: Drafted from the standard template. It is waiting for you in Waiting for approval.
createdSending: Approved by your rules. The messages are being sent a few at a time.
templateReason: OpenClaw did not write this one: {reason}
reason_quota: the AI quota is used up.
reason_timeout: it took too long to answer.
reason_not_configured: OpenClaw is not set up yet.
draftEditHint: Keep {ten_khach} so each customer's name is filled in.
campaignsEmptyBody: Offers you prepare appear here with how many were sent.
campaignCounts: {sent} sent, {queued} waiting to send, {failed} failed, {skipped} skipped
pendingEmptyBody: Points, rewards and offers that need your approval show up here.
programFailed: The programme settings could not be loaded
setEarnHint: How customers earn points when they buy.
setPerThousandHint: For example 1 means a 100,000 VND bill earns 100 points.
setMinOrderHint: Smaller orders earn nothing. 0 means no minimum.
setTriggerHint: Choose the moment points are given.
setCategoriesHint: If the order contains the word, that rate is used when it is higher than the normal one.
setTiersHint: Tiers follow total spend. The first tier starts at 0.
setTierFirst: The first tier always starts at 0.
setTierWinbackHint: Days without a purchase before this tier counts as lapsed.
setExpiryHint: Points that are not used expire after some months.
setWarnDaysHint: How early to warn about points about to expire.
setBirthdayOn: Give a gift in the birthday month
setBirthdayNoteHint: For example: valid until the end of the month.
setMaxPerMonth: Most offers per customer in 30 days
setBatchHint: Offers go out a few at a time.
setPublicOn: Let customers check their points on the public page
errTierOrder: Each tier must start at a higher spend than the one before.
errHours: Write the time as hh:mm, for example 08:00.
